title: Understanding the Model
text: The model is defined as f_theta(x)=theta_0+theta_1*veg+theta_2*(meat=beef)+theta_3*(meat=fish). This means that the coefficients $$\theta_2$$ and $$\theta_3$$ are used to account for the type of meat. If the meat is beef, $$\theta_2$$ is used, and if it's fish, $$\theta_3$$ is used. If it's chicken, neither $$\theta_2$$ nor $$\theta_3$$ is used.

title: Substituting Values
text: For the second data point, $$veg=3$$ and $$meat=fish$$. Substitute these values into the model equation: $$\operatorname{f_{\theta}}\left(x\right)=\theta_0+3\theta_1+\theta_3$$.

title: Calculating the Prediction
text: Using the values of theta, calculate the prediction: $$\operatorname{f_{\theta}}\left(x\right)=-3+5\times3+12$$.

title: Finding the Squared Error
text: Now, calculate the squared error using the formula $$\left(actual-predicted\right)^2$$. What is the squared error for the second data point?
